Great Pizza
Aug 2018 • Business
I was staying in a near by hotel and looking for something quick and found this place.

I was craving American food so I ordered the pizza thinking it would just be ok. Its really hard to mess up pizza but to my surprise the pizza was very good. Even though the staff could not really understand my southern American accent they figured out that I wanted the crust crispy and it came out perfect, It was actually better than most pizza I get in American. 

I would go back for this pizza once a week if I lived there.
